name: amend_force_replaces_hand_written
comment: Owner ruling: 'even for [hand-written], it should be able based on the latest current schema compared with the one in migration.' With --force a fully hand-written version is replaced from the model vs the recorded past; every replaced hand-written file is named so its raw SQL/hooks/data can be re-added by hand. The regenerated version carries the header and amends freely from then on.
